kill_fact: No single fact fully breaks the bear thesis (the structural-regulatory-attack + float-vs-excess-cash + sector-beta-not-alpha case survives against primary sources), but three load-bearing claims were materially wrong: (1) the 'net cash ~EUR2.0bn war chest' is a float double-count - the H1 FY26 release (28-Feb-2026) reports NET FINANCIAL CASH of only EUR1,270m, and the distributable picture is ~EUR1,350m gross cash (excl. restricted) vs EUR1,271m gross debt = ~EUR79m true net, with the EUR2.1bn 'unrestricted float cash' being exactly the float the CFO said NOT to add back; (2) the protective Brazil injunction was already OVERTURNED on 24-Feb-2026 (Reuters) - a judge overruled the earlier suspensions and the solicitor-general said companies 'must resume complying immediately,' so the PAT commission-cap / 15-day reimbursement / interoperability hit is LIVE, not litigated-away as the bull/dossier 'green flag' implies; (3) Brazil is 29% of revenue / ~30% of float per Pluxee's own release, NOT the dossier's '~50% revenue impact.'
corrections: Net cash corrected from ~EUR2.0bn to EUR1,270m reported (true distributable excess far smaller - validates the bear's float-vs-excess-cash trap; SoP cash overlay should be cut toward ~EUR0.0-0.3bn, not EUR0.5-2.0bn). Brazil concentration corrected to 29% of revenue / ~30% of float (not ~50%). Catalyst/injunction status corrected: the Jan-27-2026 injunction was OVERTURNED 24-Feb-2026; Brazil PAT reform compliance is now mandatory and impacts began H2 FY26, extending into H1 FY27 with recovery only from H2 FY27. Share count ~144m (per H1 EPS math), not 138m. Price ~EUR11.4 (17-Jun-2026); analyst consensus target ~EUR16.6 - well below the EUR25.5 base SoP.
evidence: Pluxee N.V. H1 Fiscal 2026 results, GlobeNewswire 16-Apr-2026: total revenue EUR655m (+5.6% organic), recurring EBITDA EUR242m (+12.9% organic), recurring EBITDA margin 37.0% (+229bps), recurring FCF EUR210m (86% conversion); NET FINANCIAL CASH EUR1,270m at 28-Feb-2026 (cash excl. restricted EUR1,350m vs gross debt EUR1,271m); restricted Float cash EUR753m, unrestricted Float cash EUR2,102m; buyback 62% of EUR100m executed in H1.

Pluxee press release 17-Nov-2025 (GlobeNewswire/Manila Times): Brazil PAT reform = 3.6% merchant-commission cap + 2% interchange ceiling + 15-day reimbursement + 360-day interoperability; Brazil = 29% of total revenue and ~30% of float; worst-case baked into FY26; impact extends into H1 FY27, profitable-growth recovery only from H2 FY27.

Reuters via Investing.com, 24-Feb-2026: a Brazilian judge OVERRULED the earlier injunctions that had suspended the PAT meal-voucher reform for Pluxee and Edenred's Ticket; solicitor-general stated companies 'must resume complying with the new rules immediately' - the Jan-2026 protective injunction is reversed.

Market data 17-Jun-2026 (Yahoo Finance / TipRanks / MLQ): PLX.PA ~EUR11.4; analyst consensus 12-mo target ~EUR16.6 (range EUR10-22.9), rating Hold/Neutral - structurally below the EUR25.5 base SoP, consistent with a priced, sector-wide regulatory de-rate rather than idiosyncratic mispricing.
